candidates.title: Custom CNC Machined Flanges
candidates.label: CNC Machined Flanges
candidates.heroDescription: Custom CNC machined flanges for pipe connections, robot tool changers, motor mounts, vacuum systems and non-standard assemblies. Send your drawing for material, machining, finishing and inspection review.
overview: A CNC machined flange provides a bolted interface between pipes, shafts, housings or equipment. Turning, milling, boring, drilling and threading control the sealing face, bore, pilot register and bolt pattern around the mating assembly.

Custom flange manufacturing is useful when a catalog part cannot meet the required bore, bolt pattern, mounting geometry, material or sealing arrangement. CNCPioneer reviews standard-based and non-standard designs for piping, robot end-effectors, motor mounts, vacuum equipment and structural connections.

candidates.title: CNC Turning Milling Parts
candidates.label: CNC Turning Milling Parts
candidates.applicationsIntro: Explore industry applications for CNC turning milling parts, with materials, interfaces and inspection requirements defined for each project.
candidates.heroDescription: Custom CNC Turning Milling Parts made to your drawing. Review critical dimensions, datums and mating features, material, finishing and inspection requirements before production.
overview: CNC turning milling — also called mill-turn machining or multi-tasking machining — combines turning operations (rotating the workpiece to produce cylindrical geometry) and milling operations (rotating the cutting tool to produce flats, keyways, slots, cross-holes, bolt circles, and compound-angled faces) in a single machine setup from one datum reference frame.

The reason is fundamental: a shaft with a keyway machined sequentially on a lathe then a milling machine must be re-registered in the milling fixture — introducing ±0.050–0.200mm repositioning error from fixture positioning uncertainty.
